description:
**CONVERTED FROM COVENTRY'S ORGINIAL VICTORIAN POWER STATION **TWO BATHROOMS** DRESSING ROOM TO MASTER** ALLOCATED PARKING**

This well presented two bedroom apartment is offered for sale with no upward chain. Having been converted from and old Victorian Power station the property boasts period features and charm.  The property is accessed by a well maintained communal entrance with the benefit of intercom facilities and a lift. Once entering the property you are greeted by an entrance hall with the two double bedrooms off, the master bedroom having an ensuite shower room and dressing room, the second bedroom benefitting from a useful storage area. There is also a modern shower room and a further storage cupboard off the main hallway before arriving at the large open plan kitchen/dining/lounge area which has an abundance of natural light. This unique and well maintained apartment must be viewed to appreciate all that it has to offer. 
Externally the property benefits from communal parking. 

Having double glazing (where specified) and electric heating, the Council tax band C.
